info.title: Juanca application shadow API
info.description: Shadow API: immutable portfolio, guided conversation, evidence and reconciliation, plus idempotent proposal review/application commands. It is not the financial authority.

get.summary: Read portfolio data and operational gates for PostgreSQL cutover

200.description: Read-only readiness report; never enables authority or writes
Scoped proposals including the explicit custody account

post.summary: Create an idempotent pending investment proposal
post.description: A reviewer, owner, or approver may create a pending draft for an identified account belonging to the selected owner. Only an owner or approver may approve or reject it. Creating a proposal does not apply an event.

422.description: Invalid input or account does not belong to owner

post.summary: Approve a proposal and atomically rebuild the published portfolio

200.description: Applied event, revision and published portfolio version

409.description: Stale portfolio, unresolved account, missing source run, insufficient position, or event dated on/before the account snapshot (requires reconciliation)

post.summary: Reject a pending proposal without changing invested holdings

200.description: Rejected proposal; audit recorded
Private B3 reconciliation candidates; no financial changes are applied

get.summary: List exact movement rows repeated across B3 documents
get.description: Candidate evidence only. Preserves each source assertion and never merges or applies financial events. preview_event_count is a reconciliation preview based on complete pairwise decisions; unresolved or contradictory decisions return null.

200.description: Candidate-only duplicate evidence; no portfolio changes

post.summary: Record an audited decision for a pair of repeated B3 movement rows
post.description: Append-only evidence review. Decisions are versioned and idempotent; they do not merge source assertions or change the portfolio.

409.description: Candidate stale or idempotency key conflict

post.summary: Record an audited review of one B3 snapshot difference
post.description: Evidence review only; no positions, cash, events or portfolio revision change.

201.description: Audited evidence-only decision; portfolio_changed is false

409.description: Idempotency mismatch or candidate no longer present

413.description: Request body exceeds the size limit

get.summary: Suggest exact written-evidence to B3 movement matches for human review

200.description: Derived candidates; household, instrument, exact quantity and date-window match; no link or portfolio change is applied

post.summary: Record an audited human decision about one written-to-B3 evidence link

201.description: Audited evidence-only decision; no positions, cash, events or portfolio revision are changed

409.description: Idempotency mismatch or candidate is stale

get.summary: Project shadow fixed-income holdings from archived price observations

200.description: Issuer- and owner-scoped projection, explicitly non-authoritative
Immutable shadow view; not financial authority

get.summary: List persisted position identities and their latest account resolution

200.description: Shadow identity evidence; does not change published holdings

get.summary: List gross acquisition quantity reconciliation for all persisted positions
get.description: Read-only shadow diagnostic. Reports current lot revisions against linked B3 snapshot quantities; sales, redemptions and transfers are not netted, and results are not portfolio balances.

200.description: Family-wide acquisition evidence reconciliation

get.summary: List append-only acquisition evidence and corrections for one position

200.description: Append-only history plus current lot revisions and a gross-acquisition quantity comparison against the linked B3 snapshot. Sales, redemptions and transfers are not netted; this is not a lot-balance certification and is excluded from portfolio calculations.

post.summary: Record or correct an acquisition lot as shadow evidence

get.summary: List custody accounts matching a provisional position owner and institution

200.description: Candidate accounts; an empty list leaves identity unresolved

post.summary: Record an audited account assignment after review

201.description: Resolution recorded; does not change published portfolio

422.description: Account does not match position owner or institution

200.description: Immutable shadow view; not financial authority
Custody account identities scoped to the authenticated household
Owners scoped to the authenticated household
Household conversation and selected read-only archive
Guided reply; stores conversation only

get.summary: List recent written evidence and local interpretations for review

200.description: Recent evidence; read-only and does not change portfolio facts

post.summary: Register original written movement as evidence pending review

201.description: Original text retained with deterministic local interpretation for human review; portfolio unchanged

409.description: Idempotency key reused for a different text

get.summary: Read the registered text and review status

200.description: Stored original evidence and any versioned local interpretation

get.summary: List recent manually uploaded photos and saved OCR/trade interpretations

200.description: Household-scoped photo metadata, versioned OCR and append-only deterministic manual-trade parser interpretations when OCR is available. Interpretations require human review and never apply portfolio facts.

post.summary: Start a manual photo upload through the application boundary

202.description: Durable upload intent; send bytes to returned content_url

get.summary: Read a stored manual photo after household and content-hash verification

200.description: Verified image bytes from private ingestion storage

404.description: Photo not found in this household

put.summary: Store photo bytes after SHA-256 and size verification

get.summary: Read the upload, document and parser status

200.description: Scoped upload status

post.summary: Start a B3, Avenue or pension document upload as immutable evidence

put.summary: Store document bytes with declared length and SHA-256 verification

422.description: Bytes or type differ from intent

get.summary: Read the document and parser job status within the configured household

200.description: Scoped status
